contact.visible.label: Show this page to visitors
contact.visible.hint: Off, and the contact page disappears from the menu and answers Not Found for everybody except you. Useful while it is still being written.

contact.meta.description.value: Get in touch about coaching and training, or to book a first conversation.
contact.meta.description.label: Search description
contact.meta.description.hint: The sentence Google shows under the page title in search results. Around 150 to 160 characters; longer is cut off mid-word.

contact.meta.titlePrefix.label: Browser tab and search result title
contact.meta.titlePrefix.hint: What comes before the business name in the browser tab and in a search result. The page name on its own is fine; something a person would search for is better.

contact.hero.heading.label: Hero heading
contact.hero.heading.hint: The pale hero above the form

contact.hero.intro.value: Whether you have a question about our courses, want to discuss coaching, or just want to say hello - we'd love to hear from you.
contact.hero.intro.label: Hero introduction
contact.hero.intro.hint: The pale hero above the form

contact.cards.email.label: Email card heading
contact.cards.email.hint: Above your email address. The address itself is not typed here: it comes from the contact email on the This Site tab, so it is the same everywhere it appears. Leave that empty and this card does not show.

contact.cards.phone.label: Phone card heading
contact.cards.phone.hint: Only shown when a phone number is set on the This Site tab.

contact.cards.location.label: Location card heading
contact.cards.location.hint: Only shown when a location is set on the This Site tab.

contact.cards.booking.label: Booking card heading
contact.cards.booking.hint: The card that links to your booking page. Only shown while bookings are switched on, on the This Site tab: with them off it would link to this page.

contact.cards.bookingNote.label: What the call is
contact.cards.bookingNote.hint: One short line under the booking heading. Say how long it takes and what it costs, because that is what somebody hesitating wants to know.

contact.form.heading.label: Form heading
contact.form.heading.hint: The form at the foot of the page

contact.form.intro.value: Fill out the form below and we'll get back to you shortly.
contact.form.intro.label: Form introduction
contact.form.intro.hint: One line under the form heading. Leave empty to leave it out

contact.form.nameLabel.label: Name box label
contact.form.nameLabel.hint: The form at the foot of the page

contact.form.namePlaceholder.label: Name box example
contact.form.namePlaceholder.hint: Shown faintly in the empty box

contact.form.emailLabel.label: Email box label
contact.form.emailLabel.hint: The form at the foot of the page

contact.form.emailPlaceholder.label: Email box example
contact.form.emailPlaceholder.hint: Shown faintly in the empty box

contact.form.phoneLabel.label: Phone box label
contact.form.phoneLabel.hint: The form at the foot of the page

contact.form.phonePlaceholder.label: Phone box example
contact.form.phonePlaceholder.hint: Shown faintly in the empty box. Worth writing in the shape of a number from wherever most of your visitors are

contact.form.typeLabel.label: Enquiry type label
contact.form.typeLabel.hint: Above the drop-down of enquiry types

contact.form.types.value:
General Enquiry
Training
Coaching
Partnership
Feedback
contact.form.types.label: Enquiry types
contact.form.types.hint: The choices in the drop-down, one per line, the first one chosen to begin with. Leave empty and the drop-down is not shown

contact.form.subjectLabel.label: Subject box label
contact.form.subjectLabel.hint: The form at the foot of the page

contact.form.subjectPlaceholder.label: Subject box example
contact.form.subjectPlaceholder.hint: Shown faintly in the empty box

contact.form.messageLabel.label: Message box label
contact.form.messageLabel.hint: The form at the foot of the page

contact.form.messagePlaceholder.value: Tell us more about your enquiry...
contact.form.messagePlaceholder.label: Message box example
contact.form.messagePlaceholder.hint: Shown faintly in the empty box

contact.form.methodLabel.label: Contact method label
contact.form.methodLabel.hint: Above the choice of email or phone

contact.form.methodEmail.label: Email choice
contact.form.methodEmail.hint: Beside the first of the two round buttons

contact.form.methodPhone.label: Phone choice
contact.form.methodPhone.hint: Beside the second of the two round buttons

contact.form.submit.label: Send button
contact.form.submit.hint: The form at the foot of the page

contact.form.sending.label: Send button while sending
contact.form.sending.hint: Replaces the button wording for the second or two it takes

contact.form.sentHeading.label: Thank-you heading
contact.form.sentHeading.hint: Replaces the form once it has been sent

contact.form.sentBody.value: Thanks for getting in touch. We'll get back to you as soon as possible.
contact.form.sentBody.label: Thank-you message
contact.form.sentBody.hint: Replaces the form once it has been sent. Say when they will hear back

contact.form.sentAgain.label: Send another button
contact.form.sentAgain.hint: Under the thank-you message, to bring the form back
